Name: BossBegoman
Notes: A large Topman boss. Appears from the sky with a cutscene when battle is activated. In order to defeat it, the player must jump on its head and spin attack it to push it into ElectricRail objects that surround his arena. In SMG1, it will always spawn a Power Star when defeated, which requires a properly configured Scenario entry.

Obj_arg0.Name: Enable Returning
Obj_arg0.Description: If SW_A is valid and deactivated, it will always move towards its initial position.

Obj_arg7.Name: Spawned Enemy Type
Obj_arg7.Description: Determines the number and type of Begoman enemies spawned by BossBegoman

DemoCast.Description: Can take part in a cutscene.
